Elena Morales: Heads-up — Nimbus Insights (enterprise) shows a ~55% drop in embeddings calls over 14d. Renewal window 2026-05-05. Procurement thread mentions SkylineAI and an internal cost review.

Derek Wu: Noted. New Head of ML (Marta Kim) on-boarded last month; she’s been pushing for cheaper vector infra. Champion is still our contact but less active.

Noor Patel: Can we surface the last two weeks' token/embedding volumes and any correlate with error/latency? I’ll check product feedback too.

SalesBot: account-summary: NimbusInsights | seats=240 | active_users=92 | next_renewal=2026-05-05 | last_activity=2026-03-19

Elena Morales: Early observations: total embeddings calls fall starting 2026-03-08; similarity queries dropped more than semantic search. Also a batch job on 3/11 retried multiple times (see traces).

Derek Wu: I saw a note in their procurement email referencing a SkylineAI pilot for "vectorized search at 10x cheaper ops". We should ask for their evaluation criteria.

Noor Patel: Quick checklist for our side:
- Gather 30/60/90d trend for embeddings tokens
- Capture p50/p95/p99 for embeddings and calls failing with 5xx
- Prepare a compact A/B plan (ours vs SkylineAI) for recall, latency, and cost

Elena Morales: Proposed playbook:
1) Book a technical sync with Marta + platform team (30m)
2) Offer a cost-comparison PoC: 2-week Dedicated with capped spend focused on their nightly batch and similarity queries
3) Deliver an enablement session on upgrade + batching optimizations
4) Provide a short eval template they can use to compare recall & cost

Derek Wu: I'll coordinate the commercial side. Can we offer a capped trial with clear SKUs? Also check their contract for auto-renew clauses.

Noor Patel: For the enablement I’ll prepare a small reproducer and a script:
```
python sim_queries.py --host=https://api.redwood.com --org=nimbus-insights --qps=40 --batch=8
```
And a CLI snippet to enable prefix cache:
```
redwoodctl deployment update --org nimbus-insights --cache prefix --max-batch 12
```

CS-Alerts: alert: SDK mismatch detected: NimbusInsights using SDK v1.1.0 while latest stable v1.2.3. Recommend upgrade.

Elena Morales: Add SDK upgrade + sample fix PR to the workshop. Also tag this account as "renewal-risk: stakeholder-change + usage-drop". Set weekly check-ins.

Derek Wu: I'll ask for their evaluation metrics during the commercial intro. Draft message:

Derek Wu:
```
Hi Marta,
We noticed a drop in your embeddings usage and saw you're running a SkylineAI pilot. Would you be open to a short technical call to align on evaluation criteria? We can run a 2-week, cost-capped Dedicated PoC to mirror your production batch workload and provide a side-by-side comparison.
Best, Derek
```

Noor Patel: LGTM. I'll prep the reproducible tests and comparison checklist (recall @ K=10, latency p50/p95, cost per 1k queries).

SalesBot: po-request: NimbusInsights | trial_type=dedicated-14d | owner=Derek Wu | id=tr-20260321-99

Elena Morales: If we don't hear back in 48 hours after outreach, escalate to AE Dir for renewal play and propose a short commercial incentive. Also loop legal if they request data retention guarantees for the PoC.

Derek Wu: Will send intro now and post available times. I'll include the evaluation template.

Noor Patel: Adding a note: check their nightly ETL change logs around 3/10 — might be a pipeline change lowering call volume.

Elena Morales: Thanks team. Keeping this thread active. Update after intro.
